beats.note: Straight cut on Think of a river; hold 4s. A metaphor, never a clinical before/after. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous V3 Creative master; long non-speaking gaps removed. Captions and covering cuts use the new word alignment.

beats.script: First was apigenin from celery juice. She said it's been shown in research to activate the receptors in the gut wall that trigger those muscle contractions. The ones that actually push food through.
beats.visual: Distinct close view of celery stalks and juice; neutral ingredient image.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 1 — give an unfamiliar name a concrete anchor; no simulated proof.

beats.emotion: Ingredient 2 — visually separate the second ingredient without an efficacy animation.
beats.note: Overlay on Second for 3s; return for clinical wording. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous V3 Creative master; long non-speaking gaps removed. Captions and covering cuts use the new word alignment.
